==================
Installation Guide
==================

First, ensure that the Jetson Orin Nano has been properly setup by following the `configuration guide <jetson_config>`.


Next, follow the `ROS2 Humble Install Guide <https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Installation.html>`_ to get ROS2 setup on the Jetson Orin Nano. 


Then run the following: 

.. code-block:: console

    $ cd ~/

    $ git clone https://github.com/shouvik-d/roboflock_ws.git

    $ cd ~/roboflock_ws

    $ rosdep install --from-paths src -y --ignore-src

    $ colcon build

    $ source install/bin/setup.bash


Check out :doc:`Managing USB Devices <manage_usb>` to get all USB devices ready for use and run through the remaining configuration guides for all other components (GPS modules, motor drivers, etc.).
